jobs.name: 小型物资箱
jobs.prompt:
Create an ANIMATION SPRITE SHEET for the exact closed chest in the reference image. Preserve its silhouette, pale/dark color masses, clasp and keyhole, distinctive swept lid, fine structural details, and opaque hand-painted block brushwork. The only moving object is its hinged LID and the small latch: the lower box stays fixed. The lid is attached along the rear edge and rotates backwards in a believable opening movement; do not detach or float it.
OUTPUT: one square RGBA transparent sprite sheet containing EXACTLY FOUR equal square cells in a perfect 2x2 grid, read left-to-right top-to-bottom. No gutters, labels, borders, numbers or background. Each cell has transparent padding. All four cells show the SAME box at EXACTLY the same camera angle, size, lower-body position and base line. Fixed local coordinates per cell: chest-body bottom at 82% height, center at 50% width; box body width about 64% of cell. The opened lid must fit above without clipping or entering another cell. Do not draw a black backing, round shadow disk, ground, drop shadow, backdrop, or scenery.
TOP LEFT: closed at rest, clasp engaged, the original tiny seam glint.
TOP RIGHT: unlocking; latch released and lid lifted about 12 degrees, a narrow line of colored-white light escapes from the seam.
BOTTOM LEFT: half open at 45 degrees; the main bright release of light rises from INSIDE the box in two or three clean tapered painterly rays, with a few tiny spark flecks. Keep box and lid clearly visible.
BOTTOM RIGHT: fully open about 85 degrees, lid still attached behind the body; the first flash has subsided to a softly illuminated empty interior and a few drifting residual sparks. Do not draw cards, coins, treasure or other contents.
Effects are generated artwork integrated into these frames, not a colored rectangle. No huge smoke, no explosive debris, no fog hiding the chest. Main form and brush scale must stay consistent across four cells. All light and particles belong only to their own cell and fade to transparent. This is a shippable hand-painted game sprite, not photoreal 3D. This is the muted grey-sage common supply case. Effect: modest cool mint-white seam light, a short delicate flash and only 2–3 small sparks. Keep the opening modest, clean and grounded.

jobs.name: 独立开箱闪光
jobs.prompt: Paint a production-quality RGBA transparent sprite sheet of a delicate hand-painted treasure-box opening LIGHT EFFECT, with EXACTLY FOUR equal square cells in a perfect 2x2 grid. No chest or other solid object, only the effect. No text, labels, lines, frame borders, background, dark disk, ground or drop shadow. All elements remain inside their own cells. Same light-source anchor in every cell at x50%,y65%. Top-left: a small thin white seam-like horizontal glimmer with a tiny bright center. Top-right: a concentrated white flash with two short feathered painterly rays pointing diagonally upward. Bottom-left: the peak open-box flash, three elongated curved ivory-white opaque brush rays expanding upward and outward, a narrow graceful broken sweep of light and 4 tiny sparks, broad transparent spaces between rays. Bottom-right: fading residual little spark dots and one short tapering wisp, much dimmer and smaller. Elegant economical anime block-brush art matching hand-painted game props. Nearly neutral warm-white core, faint cool/lavender edge; no rainbow, no realistic volumetric smoke, no large hazy orb. Genuinely transparent alpha background.

mediumLayoutRepair: 编辑图1的四格开箱动画帧板；图2只用于核对箱体原设计。保留图1四个状态的箱体设计、烟紫白配色、笔触、锁扣、内光和稀疏光粒。只修正排版和对齐：严格等分2×2正方形网格，每个状态必须完整处于自己的单元格，四个单元边缘至少留出10%透明空白，任何箱盖、微光或粒子都不能越过格线。每格内箱体宽度约为格宽的65%；箱身底边固定在各自格高的82%，箱身中心x50%，视角和箱身大小保持完全一致，不因开盖缩放/变形。顺序为左上闭合，右上解锁小开缝，左下45度半开并发出白紫短光束，右下约85度全开并只剩余辉。为下排抬起的箱盖预留上方空间，不可顶到单元格上边，也不能把下排箱盖画进上排。所有格外空白真RGBA透明，无画出的格线、边框、文字、地面、黑底或投影。不改变箱子设计或增加粒子，不画箱内物品。
